questions.question: What is the agency model?
questions.answer: Your Meta account. You pay Meta for messages. We provide dashboard, API, webhooks. No markup.

questions.question: Why do I pay Meta separately?
questions.answer: Meta bills usage. We charge setup (from 400€) + platform (149€/month).

questions.question: Do I own my WhatsApp account?
questions.answer: Yes. You own your Meta account. We help configure it at setup.

questions.question: Is this for marketing campaigns?
questions.answer: No. We're built for transactional messages only: order updates, delivery alerts, reminders, verification codes. No marketing campaigns or CRM blasts — so you get better deliverability and compliance.

questions.question: What is GetNotify?
questions.answer: Official WhatsApp Cloud API on your Meta account. You get a dashboard, REST API, and webhooks to send transactional messages: order confirmations, alerts, OTPs. You pay Meta for messages; we're the software layer. No marketing — focus on what users expect and need.

questions.question: Who is it for?
questions.answer: Teams that need reliable WhatsApp notifications and an API. E‑commerce, operations, product.

questions.question: How do I start?
questions.answer: Contact for setup (from 400€). Then platform (149€/month). You pay Meta for messages.

questions.question: Who bills messages?
questions.answer: Meta. We charge setup + platform. Dashboard shows estimated Meta cost.

questions.question: Cancel platform?
questions.answer: Contact to cancel. See T&C for notice.

questions.question: Refunds?
questions.answer: No refund for messages. Platform per T&C.

questions.question: Data security?
questions.answer: HTTPS/TLS. We do not resell data.

questions.question: Who operates GetNotify?
questions.answer: Uphold SRL, Romania. Invoices from Uphold. You pay Meta for messages.
